answer_1.quote: we present UN-OWN (Figure ), a novel approach that uses pre-trained language models (PLMs) to generate synthetic training examples for FC systems, integrating textual and tabular evidence.

answer_2.quote: We assess FC predictions using Accuracy and F1 scores ([0, 1]; higher is better), distinguishing between Supports and Refutes labels.

answer_4.quote: We perform a qualitative analysis to investigate the quality of the claims generated by UNOWN. ... enlist the expertise of three external annotators ... to evaluate the claims. ... we ask the annotators to determine which claim is the best with respect to two dimensions: clarity ... and coherence ...
answer_4.guideline: Direct comparison assessment of generated vs. original claims based on clarity and coherence, with tie option.
